CustomField.description: 2014-10-23 JR | Added to track whether customer is using a Self-signed SSL certificate to secure the console communication.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select "Self-signed" if the server uses the default self-signed SSL cert; otherwise, choose "Certificate Authority Signed" if the SSL certificate is signed by either the customer's internal certificate signing authority or an external CA such as VeriSign.
CustomField.label: SSL Certificate
